name: Isaac
overview: The Scriptures reveal Isaac as the long-promised son of Abraham and Sarah, whose birth was divinely assured as part of God's covenantal blessing (Genesis 17:15-16; 18:10). God's faithfulness in granting Isaac to Sarah in her old age underscores His sovereign power and purpose (Genesis 21:1). Moreover, Isaac is established as the child through whom Abraham's descendants will be named, highlighting his critical role in the unfolding of God's redemptive plan (Genesis 21:12).
